items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of orthopedic insoles
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 14 Apr 2025, sent by a health insurer (public body under SGB X). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter posted by an authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Mon 14 Apr + 4 days = Fri 18 Apr 2025 (for social-law letters this day does not shift even though it falls on Karfreitag, a public holiday). Counting the one-month period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later, on Sun 18 May 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). Since that day is a Sunday, the deadline moves to the next business day, Mon 19 May 2025 (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). This date has already passed as of today.

warnings: The Widerspruch deadline of 2025-05-19 has already passed relative to today's date (2026-09-26); if this letter is being acted on now, the objection period is long over and the decision has likely become final unless a later extension or exception applies.
No specific reimbursement amount for the two standard insoles (minus the statutory co-payment) is stated in the letter, so no amount could be extracted.
